notes: Real-time chat release. Layer 1: the MCP process long-polls its rooms after the first tool call and writes PLUGIN_DATA/inbox.jsonl (0600) — one line per foreign message, trust-matrix judged, held rows metadata-only; AGENT_ROOM_NOTIFY_CMD (execFile) and tail -F are the host-native wake paths; AGENT_ROOM_NOTIFIER=off disables. Layer 2: agent-room wait fixed per issue #4 (own sends never wake; page read + in-memory baseline). Named follow-up: recalibrate the REL-3 FD corridor if the soak is ever run with the notifier on (children pin it off). No server-side change; the v0.3.0 REL-3 qualification covers the unchanged server core.
